tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gi tshar chen gyi gsung la zin bris ni gu'i phyag len bzhugs so// ni gu'i sgyu lus dbang mo che'i tshe dkyil 'khor sbreng tshar re re'i mdun du zlum gtor re/ lha bshos re/ mgon po'i maṇ+ḍal gyi khar gtor ma gru sum mda' dar can/ mdun du mchod pa sbreng tshar dbang gi sngon du/ bgegs gtor drag rol/ sngon 'gro rnams chos rje ston pa'i yi ge bzhin ye shes dbab pa'i tshe/ slob ma bde mchog lhan skyes 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor sogs kye rdor bzhin/ bum dbang la dbang dang bum chu byin/ gsang dbang la thod chang byin/ gong ma gnyis la ku shas yul tsam mdzad/ dbang man ngag dang 'brel ba'i thog mar maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun pa lan gsum/ yi ge lnga 'od du zhu ba'i thig le lte bar lnga tshoms su 'god/ re re la ḍā dril dang hrī ha ha bla ma brgyud pa'i byin rlabs brjod/ rtsas lam sbyangs pa'i tshe/ yi ge'i 'od kyi 'khor lo de dang de gang bas/ rtsa'i mdud pa thams cad sbrul mdud ltar rang grol du gyur/ mthar lus kyi rtsa mdud thams cad grol bar sgom/ gdams ngag dbang dang 'brel ba'i dbu ma'i yar snar haṃ gi rtser thig le dkar po yungs 'bru tsam/ gsang gnas su hūm̐ sngon po mgo gyen bstan gyi rtser thig le dmar po yungs 'bru tsam/ hūm̐ gyen du byon/ dbu ma sgyu ma zlog pa ltar thim nas snying khar sleb hūm̐ thig le la thim/ haṃ mar byon/ dbu ma sgyu ma zlog pa ltar thim nas snying khar sleb haṃ thig le la thim/ thig le dkar po'i rjes su dmar pos ded par bsam pa sogs 'dra/ mthar de ltar dbang thob pas bdag brgyud dam tshig dang ldan pa la dgyes pa'i tshul du mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal sil ba tshal du gsal ba nas mgon po mdun gyi nam mkha' la 'ur chem gyis byon/ khyod kyi bar chad nges sel/ 'phrin las nges bsgrub ces gsung lhang lhang bzhugs pa'i thugs kha nas hūm̐ me 'bar ba re nar gyis chad/

rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying khar lam gyis zhugs pas bar chad thams cad bsrungs bar bsam la/ gtor ma mgo bor bzhag cing / oṃ badz+ra mahā kā la sogs kyi mthar dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho brjod/ de nyin 'di ka'i khrid kyi go bcad na'ang yong ngo / /de nas sogs 'dra/ gtum mo bde chen gyi dbang la/ yig brgya gsol 'debs grub nas/ sarba big+nan na ma/ sarba sogs gsum gyi mthar bden pa brdar te drag rol dang bcas pas bgegs gtor phyir dor/ dga' chen khyed bdag gis gsol ba gdab/ bu tshur shog gi gnang ba byin/ rtog pa bsdu ba/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs kyi rgyun gshegs/ bde stong du sems bskyed/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang / gzhal yas khang phyi mchod rten mgo lnga pa la nang rgyal khab kyi gnam sa'i dbus su seng khri la bla ma dang ngo bo gcig la rnam pa tha dad pa'i bde mchog lha lnga mngon rtogs bzhin gsal btab/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs kha'i 'od kyi sbyangs pa'i slob ma bde mchog lhan skyes su rgyas par bskyed pa'i dpral bar oṃ sogs/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad bde mchog lha lnga'i rnam par bstim zhing hrīḥ ha ha dang rol chen/ dbang dngos gzhi la/ slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i 'od kyis mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor slob ma'i spyi bo'i thad tsam mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ dbang re re la ḍā dril dang yi ge bdun pa'i mthar/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyis da lta nyid du sogs brjod/ de nas sogs 'dre'o/ nyin bar gyis 'khrul pa bzlog pa sgyu lus kyi dbang la/ sngon 'gro rnams 'dra/ mdun bskyed gzhal yas khang gi dbus pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar seng khri pad nyi tshangs pa brgya byin gyi steng du kye rdor phyag gnyis pa yab yum/ 'dab ma brgyad la gau rī sogs lha mo brgyad mtshan tsam gsal btab/ slob ma kye rdor du bskyed ye shes dbab pa 'dra/

dngos gzhi/ slob ma kye rdor du gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus drang por dbu ma dkar gsal yar rtse tshangs bug tu kha shag gi bye ba gsal btab/ ma snar ram/ slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i 'od kyi mdun gyi kye rdo rje spyi bor spyan drangs/ dbang dngos re re la ḍā dril dang / de wa pi tsu bla ma brgyud pa'i byin rlabs/ de nas sogs 'dra/ mtshan mo'i 'khrul pa bzlog pa rmi lam gyi dbang la sngon 'gro 'dra/ mdun du rgyud sde lnga gtso sprul gsal gdab/ 'di la bskyed rim gyi dbang bzhi dang / rdzogs rim zhu bde'i dbang bzhi'i dbang yod pas yig rnying rang la gtso bor rten dgos/ slob ma bde mchog du bskyed/ ye shes dbab/ dngos gzhi dpon slob gnyis ka'i lus la rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga'i lte bar/ hūm̐ hrī hūm̐ maṃ bkod/ slob dpon gyi yig 'bru lhar gsal ba las 'od 'phros slob ma'i yi ge lnga lhar bskyed de/ lte bar 'jam rdor lha bcu dgu mtshan tsam gyi gsal gdab/ lha so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i 'od kyis 'khor lo so so khengs par bsam zhing / ḍā dril dang so so'i sngags/ zhu bde'i dbang gi rjes su/ rmi lam gyi khyad par gyi byin rlabs rang bde mchog du gsal ba'i smin mtshams su thig le dkar po sran ma tsam gyi nang du yi ge bdun pa kha dog sngon po 'od kyi rang bzhin 'khrug 'khrug pa la sems gtad rmi lam gyi dran 'dun gtong du bzhugs/ rjes 'dra'o/ /'od gsal gyi dbang la/ mdun bskyed bde mchog lha lnga gsal btab/ slob ma bde mchog tu bskyed la ye shes phab/ dbang dngos re re la ḍā dril dang yi ge bdun pa/ rjes 'dra'o/ /'pho ba'i dbang la/ mdun bskyed gzhal yas khang gi nang du chos 'byung gru sum nyis rtsegs kyi nang du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bskyed/ slob ma seng khri'i steng du bde mchog du bskyed/ ye shes dbab/ dngos gzhi la/ mkha' spyod ma mar me gnyis chad kyi tshul du mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/

dbang bzhi la ḍā dril dang oṃ gsum ma/ 'pho ba'i khyad par gyi byin rlabs la/ mdun gyi rnal 'byor ma byon/ slob ma bde mchog tu gsal ba'i dpung pa gnyis kyi steng du zhabs bzhag gsang gnas pad ma dmar po kha phye ba lta bu tshangs bug dang sprad pa'i rnam par gsal btab/ lte bar rang sems a dkar po 'phur la khad pa rgod kyi the thung lta bu rang rlung gis yom yom skyod bzhin pa des gyen du ltas pas tshangs bug skya ha re ba de nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsang gnas mthong / der 'gro ba'i 'dun pa drag pos/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su 'khrid du gsol/ lan gsum/ thugs kha nas 'od zer dkar po ba thag brkyang pa lta bu nar gyis byon/ spyi bo nas zhugs/ lte ba'i a la reg pas khab len la lcags 'ju ba ltar 'then nas/ lus kyi dbus na yar ye re re song / tshangs bug nas don/ bha ga nas zhugs thugs khar slebs pa tsam la rtog sgra dang bcas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nam mkha' la yed kyis byon/ blos 'khyud chud du byon pa dang dag pa mkha' spyod du phebs par bsam/ rnal 'byor ma 'ja' yal ba ltar bsam la rig pa brjod med du 'jog ḍā dril rol chen/ oṃ gsum ma/ yang nam mkha' la sprin rdol ba bzhin rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lam gyis byon/ mar babs dpung pa'i steng du zhabs bzhag pa'i thugs kha nas rang sems a cha lte bar slebs/ yang gsol 'debs sogs gong bzhin te/ dril bas tshar gsum mdzad/ mthar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'od du zhu spyi bo nas thim pas spyi bo sra zhing mkhregs pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsam/ rjes 'dra'o/ /bar do'i dbang bskur la/ slob ma kye rdor du bskyed pa la ye shes dbab pa'i rol chen yan 'dra/ mdun bskyed kye rdor lha dgu slob ma'i spyi bor spyan drangs/ dbang gzhi la de wa pi tsu dang ḍā dril/ rjes su bar do'i byin rlabs rang gi mdun du chos 'byung sngon po spang rgyan kha 'byed pa lta bu'i nang du/

rang sems hūm̐ sngon po'i 'od kyis 'das ma 'ongs da ltar gyi mngal gyi lan chags/ bag chags/ dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ snang srid thams cad dges rdor yab yum du lam me bsal ba la rmi lam sgyu ma bar do'i dran bdun mthar 'dzin med du ci gnas 'jog rjes 'dra'o/ /bde mchog lha lnga'i byin rlabs la/ bgegs gtor nas/ ye shes dbab pa'i bar sngon 'gro 'bring po bzhin las rgyun bshags rjes su rigs lnga'i sdom bzung / dngos gzhi mkhas btsun pa'i yi ge bzhin la/ bum dbang gi dbang gzhi rdzogs pa'i mthar ḍā dril/ dbang gzhan gsum la ḍā dril te/ 'di la phyi'i dbang rgyas pa gcig yod tshod 'dug na'ang chad/ da lta 'di gcig pu yin gsungs/ rang sems 'chi med kyi byin rlabs la ye shes dbab pa yan 'dra/ slob dpon bde mchog tu gsal ba'i gnas gsum du 'bru gsum/ lte bar hūm̐ kha dog lnga ldan gsal btab/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dbang gzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ lan gsum/ slob dpon gyi dpral ba'i oṃ las 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog dkar po sku chung la yan lag rags pa bde ba chen po'i gar ling ling mdzad pa dpag tu med pa byon/ rang gi smin mtshams nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang bas bum pa'i dbang thob sogs/ hrī ha ha ḍā dril/ sku gsung thugs 'gre/ slob dpon gyi gnas gsum gyi 'bru gsum rgyang gis 'chad/ khyed rang gi gnas gsum du lam me bzhugs/ yang slob dpon gyi lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'khor lo bde mchog kha dog sna tshogs pa sku chung la yan lag rags pa bde ba chen po'i gar ling ling mdzad pa dpag tu med pa byon/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dag dbang bzhi pa thob/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs/ slar slob dpon gyi lte ba'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ gcig rgyang gi 'chad rang gi lte bar zhugs/

spyi bo'i oṃ āḥl āḥ hūm̐ la hūm̐ lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim/ de'i rkyen gyi sku lus rdos bcas rnam smin sha khrag gi phung pos gtso byas snang zhing srid pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad 'od du ya la la stong nyid du thim par bsam la ḍā dril/ stong nyid de'i ngang las 'khor lo sdom pa 'od kyi rang bzhin sgyu ma lta bur lam gyis gyur par bsam/ rjes 'dra'o/ /lam 'khyer rnam gsum gyi byin rlabs la/ slob ma bde mchog du bskyed pa la ye shes dbab pa'i rol chen lan gcig gis 'thus/ de nas maṇ+ḍal/ dang po srung 'khor dur khrod bcas pa'i dbus su chud pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i lte bar seng khri pad nyi la bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bde mchog ser po/ shar du dgyes mdzad/ lhor gsang 'dus/ nub tu sgyu ma chen po/ byang du drag po rdo rje 'jigs byed rnams gsal btab/ maṇ+ḍal dbul/ de dag la lus longs spyod thams cad dang / stong gsum thams cad 'dzam bus gser gyis bkang ba ltos med du phul/ khyad par mdun du thod pa'i nang du rang lus lings kyis skyur bas 'chi med kyi bdud rtsis ltems kyis zhu ba de phul bas thugs rgyud bde chen gyis tshims par/ bdag la dgyes bzhin bzhugs pa la mos gus byas pas dkyil 'khor las de 'dra ba 'chad rang gi smin mtshams kyi thad tsam gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa de'i thugs kha nas 'od 'phros skyabs gnas thams cad kyi byin rlabs 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i lha lnga la thim/ bla ma rin po cher bdag la bum pa'i dbang bskur du gsol/ sku'i byin rlabs dbab du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de dag gi sku'i cha shas thams cad dang gdan las 'od zer dkar gyi khu ba lta bu chi li li babs/ rang gi smin mtshams yan chad gang / bum pa'i dbang thob sogs/ rgyud sde gtso bo lnga yum bcas kyi sngags dang /

rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi sogs dang / ḍā dril/ byin rlabs bsdus/ gsol gdab/ mgrin/ thugs kyi 'od kyis dbang gnyis/ rten dang brten pa phyi nas rim bzhin 'od du zhu/ bla ma la thim/ bla ma dang gtso bo dbyer med rang la thim/ 'od du yal nas stong nyid kyi ngang du rig pa brjod med du 'jog dbang re re la sngags rol 'dra'o/ /de nas maṇ+ḍal gnyis pa bde mchog lha lngar gsal btab/ maṇ+ḍal nas bdud rtsi'i bar phul/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par skur du gsol/ lan gsum/ bla ma'i dpral ba nas 'khor lo bde mchog gi sku'i ngo bor gyur pa'i bde mchog dkar po sku chung la yan lag rags pa sngags kyi sgra bsgrog pa/ bung ba tshang nas rdol ba bzhin du skya chem chem 'phros/ rang gi smin mtshams nas zhugs/ lus thams cad khengs/ bum pa'i dbang thob sogs/ mgrin pa nas dmar/ snying kha nas sngo/ slar gnas gsum char nas dkar dmar mthing gsum khra chem chem 'phros/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim pas dbang bzhi pa sogs/ dbang re re la hrī ha ha/ sogs dang ḍā dril sogs maṇ+ḍal gsum pa'i bde mchog lha lngar gsal ba la maṇ+ḍal nas gsol gdab kyi bar snga ma bzhin/ slob ma 'khor lo sdom pa 'od kyi rang bzhin du gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma kha dog dkar gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin rtsa ba phra ba lte bar zug pa'i nang du raṃ dmar po/ rgya gling gi sham kha ltar je sbom du song ba tshangs pa'i bu gar har re yod pa gsal btab/ mdun bskyed la de 'dra ba tshangs bug gi steng gi nam mkhar byon/ sku lus thams cad las bdud rtsi shel dkar bzhu ba'i khu ba lta bu babs/ tshangs bub nas zhugs smin mtshams yan chad gang bas bum dbang / mdun bskyed kyi mgrin pa nas 'od dkar dmar nyi zla 'dres pa ltar du 'phros/ mgrin pa nas zhugs lus thams cad khengs pas gsang dbang / mdun bskyed kyi yum las yum du char/

rang gi yum rdo rje phag mo la thim/ snyoms par zhugs pas dga' bzhi'i ye shes skyes pa gsum pa/ mdun bskyed 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas thim pas/ rang lhar gsal ba la thim pas je dengs je dengs nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar bsam brjod med du 'jog pa bzhi pa/ dbang re re la hrīḥ ha ha sogs dang ḍā dril sogs/ 'jug gsum ka la thun mong du dengs nas sogs mdzad/ su kha chos drug gi byin rlabs/ maṇ+ḍal dbus dkar dmar/ shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'i 'dab ma bzhi/ tshom bu dkar dmar gcig 'god/ bdag mdun du 'di nas mkha' 'gro ma su kha sku mdog dung ltar dkar ba/ dbu skra bsil bur 'phyang shing / rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas pa thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ g.yon skye med mtshon pa'i phyag rgya ched du 'phyar tsam mdzad pa/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs kyi rnam pa/ ye shes kyi sku can zhig bsam/ kham rang la mdzad/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus bya/ maṇ+ḍal nas slob ma su khar bskyed pa la ye shes dbab pa'i bar gyi sngon 'gro 'dra/ dngos gzhi la/ maṇ+ḍal bsrungs 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa'i dbus su chud pa'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i su kha gsal btab/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ gang gi drin sogs sho lo ka gcig gi mthar/ bdag la dbang bzhi bskur du gsol/ brgya pa lan gsum/ mdun bskyed pa'i gnas gsum du 'bru gsum gsal btab/ dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od dkar po byung / rang gi smin mtshams nas zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob sogs/ mgrin/ snying / gnas gsum char gyi spro bsdus dbang bzhi rim bzhin bskur/ re re la sngags dang bcas pa'i ḍā dril re/ mthar slob ma lus gnad bcas mig mdun gyi bar snang stong la her gtad/ mdun bskyed kyi phyag g.yon skye med mtshon pa'i phyag rgya ched du phyar tsam mdzad de/ nam mkha' rig med stong pa la/ /rig bcas sems kyi rtsa ba bcun/ /rtsa ba bcun la lhug par zhog

/ces lan gsum gsung bar bsam la/ de'i don/ nam mkha' dang rang sems dbyer med du bsres nas brjod med du bzhag pa'i tshe ni/ nam mkha' la skye 'jig med pa bzhin du rang sems la skye 'jig med/ nam mkha' la mtha' dbus/ ngos bzung ci yang med pa bzhin du rang sems kyang de ltar shes par byas la de kha'i ngang du 'dzin pa mi bya/ bcas bcos mi bya bar rang babs su zhog ces brjod/ rjes 'dra'o/ /'di la nges par tshogs 'khor cig mdzad do/ /mkha' spyod dkar mo'i byin rlabs/ ye shes dbab pa yan 'dra/ mdun bskyed bla ma ngo bo gcig la rnam pa tha dad pa'i mkha' spyod dkar mo mngon rtogs brjod de nam mkha' la bya lding ba ltar ling ling bzhugs pa la maṇ+ḍal/ bla ma rin po che bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ gsum pa/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad spyan drangs/ dpral ba'i oṃ la thim/ de las sku'i ngo bor gyur pa'i 'od zer dkar po dpag du med pa byung / slob ma'i dpral ba nas zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob sogs/ mgrin thugs kyis gsang shes gnas gsum bcar gyi spro bsdus bzhi pa/ re re la ḍā dril dang oṃ gsum ma brgyud pa'i byin dbab dang bcas pa/ gtor mas byin rlabs ni/ gtor ma mkha' spyod ma dkar mo gsal ba de nyid nam mkha' la bya 'phur ba bzhin yer gyis rang rang gi spyi bo nas sib kyis thim par bsam la/ oṃ gsum ma'i zhabs su dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ brjod cing spyi bor bzhag rjes 'dra/ mkha' spyod dmar mo'i dbang ni 'pho ba'i dbang de kha yin pas spros pa la dga' na ldabs la bya/ bsdu na mi dgos gsung / mkha' spyod gsum phrugs la maṇ+ḍal zlum skor mu khyud sngon po bzhi ljang ba'i dbus su 'ja' skor nor bu mig gsum lta bu la tshom bu re re 'god/

ye shes dbab pa'i rol chen yan 'dra/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i 'ja' 'od lnga'i zlum skor nor bu mig gsum pa lta bu'i g.yas kyi zlum skor du bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog gser btso ma lta bu/ dbus kyi zlum skor du mkha' spyod ma dkar mo/ g.yon gyi zlum skor du ye shes mgon po rnams mngon sum bzhin bzhugs pa de dang / bla ma rnam pa tha dad la ngo bo tha mi dad pa/ de dag gi mtha' bskor dang / steng gi nam mkha' la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems sprin phung 'thibs pa bzhin bzhugs pa la/ maṇ+ḍal gsol btab gong bzhin/ bla ma 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba'i dpral bar sku'i mkha' spyod ma dkar mo/ mgrin par gsung gi mkha' spyod ma dmar mo/ thugs khar thugs kyi mkha' spyod ma mthing ka bsam pa'i dpral ba'i mkha' spyod ma'i gsang gnas nas 'od zer dkar po nam mkha'i khams gang bar 'phros/ de dag phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur te sangs rgyas byang sems de dag la phul bas/ bzang lan gyi tshul du/ sku'i byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par byung / bla ma'i dbu gtsug nas zhugs sku'i nang thams cad khengs pas bdag gi lus kyi sgo nas bla ma la brnyas pa/ thugs 'khrugs pa'i rgyu byas pa sogs lus kyi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad ming tsam yang med par sangs kyi dag sku'i dam tshig nyams chag thams cad bskangs/ bla ma sku rdo rje'i ngo bor gyur/ mkha' spyod ma'i gsang gnas nas 'od zer dkar po byung / slob ma'i dpral ba nas zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob sogs/ mgrin pa/ snying kha dang / gsum ka nas spro bsdu gong bzhin byas pa'i dbang bzhi re re la ḍā dril/ oṃ gsum ma na mo budha ya'i gsol 'debs dang bcas pa re/ de bla ma la rten pa'i dbang bzhi yin/ yi dam gyi dbang bzhi'i slad du/ mdun gyi mkha' spyod ma dkar mo la mos gus byas dbang bzhi bskur du gsol snyam pa byas pas/

de'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ de dag phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod par gyur nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la phul/ de dag gi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad bsdus gnas gsum nas thim/ de'i gsang gnas nas 'od dkar dmar mthing gsum nam mkha'i khams gang bar byung / dkar po dpral ba/ dmar po mgrin pa/ sngon po snying kha nas zhugs/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ dbang bzhi cig char du thob par bsam la ḍā dril dang sngags tshar gcig chos skyong gi dbang bzhi'i slad du g.yon na bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum du oṃ ā hūm̐ bkod la/ dbang bzhi bskur du gsol snyam pa byas pas/ gnas gsum nas 'od zer spro bsdu sngar bzhin byas/ mgon po'i gnas gsum nas 'od dkar dmar mthing gsum nam mkha' gang ba byung sogs/ ḍā dril sngags bcas tshar gcig rjes 'dra'o/ /bde mchog gsang sgrub kyi dbang la maṇ+ḍal mu khyud sngon po pad+ma 'dab bzhi/ shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba sngo tshom bu gcig ye shes dbab pa yan 'dra/ mdun bskyed bla ma rnam pa tha dad la ngo bo tha mi dad pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog du gsal ba'i gnas gsum na sku gsung thugs kyi bde mchog lha lnga mngon sum bzhin bzhugs pa la maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab gong bzhin/ slob ma bde mchog tu gsal ba'i spyi bor bh+ruṃ las/ 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bzhi pa rtsibs kyi rtse la raṃ dmar po rlung gi skyod bzhin la/ lte bar zla nyi 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan dang bcas pa/ mgrin pa dang snying khar yang bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i 'khor lo dmar sngo/ gzhan gong bzhin bsam/ bla ma'i spyi bo'i bde mchog la mos gus byas pas/ de las sku'i bde mchog gi ngo bor gyur pa'i hūm̐ dkar po dang baṃ dmar po 'chad/ slob ma'i spyi bo'i 'khor lo'i lte bar byon pas sku'i bde mchog yab dkar/

yum dmar/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi ka'ang dkar mor gsal btab/ rlung gis skyod pa'i raṃ las me 'od byung ba phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod par gyur te phul bas/ de dag sku las 'od zer 'phros pas/ skyabs yul thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs bsdus lus thams cad gang / sku la thim pas rkyen byas/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi ka'ang yab kyi ngo bo khā ṭ+wāṃ ka sbyar bas/ sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun dkar po byung / bum pa'i dbang thob sogs/ hrīḥha ha dang ḍā dril mgrin thugs dang / yang slob ma'i gnas gsum na bzhugs pa'i bde mchog lha lnga'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum byung lus thams cad khengs/ mthar spyi bo'i lha lnga mgrin pa la thim/ de snying kha la thim/ gdan 'khor lo 'khor bzhi la thim/ de yum yab la thim/ de je phra je chung nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar bsam la ḍā dril/ rjes 'dra/ phyag rdor gsang sgrub kyi byin gyis brlabs pa la/ maṇ+ḍal gong dang 'dra/ slob ma phyag rdor du skyed pa la ye shes dbab pa yan 'dra/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed rnam pa tha dad la ngo bo tha mi dad pa'i phyag rdor du gsal ba la maṇ+ḍal gsol gdab gong bzhin/ bla ma'i dpral ba nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'od dkar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dpral ba'i oṃ la thim/ de las sku'i ngo bor gyur pa'i 'od zer dkar po dpag du med pa byung / slob ma'i dpral ba nas bzhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob sogs/ ḍā dril dang oṃ badz+ra ha li dza li ha na sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa a be sha ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ mgrin/ thugs/ gsum ka'i spro bsdus dbang bzhi re re la ḍā dril dang sngags 'dra/ de ltar dbang bzhi skur ba la rten nas khyed rang rnam pa'i sgo gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag pas skad cig gis pad+ma dang zla ba bgegs kyi rgyal po a pa ra tsi ta'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa phyag g.yas dang po rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar zhing /

g.yon dang po sdigs mdzub sgreng ba/ 'og ma gnyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par lam gyi sgom pa ni lha dngos kyis rjes su gnang ba'o/ /slob ma'i snying kha'i zla ba la hūm̐/ slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i hūm̐ las hūm̐ yig gnyis pa sogs sngags kyi rjes bzlos lan gsum/ bcom ldan bdag la dang / 'di la sogs/ rjes 'dra rnam 'joms gsang sgrub kyi byin rlabs la/ maṇ+ḍal gong bzhin gyi steng du bum pa bshams/ bgegs gtor nas/ dbang bzhi'i bar lha sngags rje ba ma rtogs phyag rdor bzhin/ khrus kyi byin rlabs pa ni/ bum pa'i nang gi lha'i sku lus thams cad las sngags phreng rang sgra sgrog pa dpag tu med pa 'u ru ru 'phros bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med du gyur/ mthar lha yang 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang dbyer med pa des lus thams cad bkrus pas mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sangs kyis dag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces yang snying brjod cing bkru/ mthar hub re 'thung du bzhugs/ 'di la 'jag pa lung tsam la rten/ byin rlabs 'di bsam pa gting pa nas brgyud pa yin gsung / rdo rje rnam 'joms sku mdog mthing kha g.yas rdo rje 'phyar zhing / g.yon dril bu skur rten pa zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis dor stabs kyi bzhugs pa'o// //rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 mkhyen brtse dbang phyug mkhyen brtse dbang phyug gi tshar chen gyi gsung la zin bris ni gu'i phyag len/
